contact.evidence_quote: You must register yourself to take the online language assessment test, after receiving the invitation by e-mail. Online Linguistic Support (OLS) is a free online language learning program designed for Erasmus+ mobility participants, in which the student tests the level of proficiency in the language that will be used abroad, and also offers the opportunity to take foreign language courses for free. ... Letter of Confirmation must be signed by the Erasmus+ coordinator on the arrival at the partner university, which confirms that the study mobility period has started.
